title: Fix CI lint: prettier formatting after package renames
description:
CI 25501293195 lint job failed with 9 prettier/prettier errors caused by the recent ig→meta and free→free-media-upload renames. The longer names pushed several lines past the column limit; prettier wants them wrapped. 8 of 9 errors are auto-fixable.

Failing files (per CI log):
- packages/provider/free-media-upload/* — FreeMediaUploadHost, UploadToAnyHostRequest, FreeMediaUploadOptions
- packages/provider/meta/* — MetaMediaCreateRequestSchema, MetaMediaPublishRequestSchema
- a top-level test referencing 'packages/provider/free-media-upload/src'

Plus one parser-config error: 'parserOptions.project has been provided for @typescript-eslint/parser' at the top of the lint output. That MAY auto-resolve once the prettier errors clear, or it may indicate an eslint config that lost a tsconfig include after the directory renames — investigate after running --fix.

**Steps:**

1. cd /Users/jwt/apicity
2. Run: pnpm install (if node_modules missing)
3. Run: pnpm run lint --fix  (or pnpm prettier --write . — check repo scripts in package.json)
4. Re-run: pnpm run lint  — must pass with 0 errors
5. If the parserOptions.project error persists after step 4, investigate eslint config (likely .eslintrc.* or eslint.config.*) — look for any 'project' path that referenced 'packages/provider/ig' or 'packages/provider/free' (now renamed) and update it.
6. Run: pnpm run build  — verify nothing else broke
7. Run: pnpm run test:run (or whatever the test command is) — verify
8. Commit: 'fix(lint): prettier auto-fix after package renames'
9. Close this bead and let the publish step push.

Reference: failed CI run https://github.com/justintanner/apicity/actions/runs/25501293195
notes: Done: fixed eslint ignore for .omp/ directory; prettier auto-fixes for free-media-upload and meta package renames were already in working tree from prior worker — committed together. Lint, build, and all 2443 tests pass.

title: Fix CI: revert over-renamed CostSource literal in cost package
description:
CI is failing the typecheck for @apicity/cost with:

  src/compute.ts(169,9): error TS2322: Type '"free-media-upload"' is not assignable to type 'CostSource'.

Recent CI runs that failed: 25500404033, 25487630731, 25487463926, 25486968004 (and earlier). All same error.

Root cause: the package rename ig→meta / free→free-media-upload over-renamed in packages/provider/cost/src/compute.ts. Line 169 is:

  source: "free-media-upload",

This is semantically wrong. The 'free' literal at that position refers to the **CostSource** type (defined in src/types.ts as 'tokens-heuristic+table' | 'per-unit-table' | 'free'), NOT to the @apicity/free-media-upload package name. The CostSource 'free' tag means 'cost is zero / no metered source'.

The case discriminator at line 165 (case "free-media-upload":) IS correctly the renamed package, but the source: literal inside the return object is a different thing — a cost-source tag.

**Fix:**

In /Users/jwt/apicity/packages/provider/cost/src/compute.ts line 169, change:

  source: "free-media-upload",

to:

  source: "free",

That single-line revert makes the type-check pass.

**Verification (you must do all of these before closing):**

1. cd to /Users/jwt/apicity
2. Install deps if needed: pnpm install
3. Run the cost build: pnpm --filter @apicity/cost run build  (or pnpm --filter @apicity/cost run typecheck)  — must succeed
4. Run the full test suite: pnpm test  (or whatever the repo's test command is — check package.json scripts)  — all tests must pass
5. Only after both pass locally, close this bead

If after step 3 you discover OTHER similar over-renames (string literals where 'free' / 'ig' meant something other than the package name), audit and fix those too. Quick check: 'grep -rn "free-media-upload\|meta" packages/provider/cost/src/' will show all current uses; any literal that's used as a TYPE TAG (not as a package name) needs to revert to its pre-rename value.

Commit message style: 'fix(cost): revert over-renamed CostSource literal'.

After your push lands, I will check the next CI run on origin/main.
notes: Done: Reverted over-renamed CostSource literal 'free-media-upload' back to 'free' in compute.ts, and fixed the matching test expectation in cost-estimate.test.ts. Build and all 2443 tests pass.
